name: oma-monorepo
description: Workspace root for the OMA AI Gateway monorepo (app/ frontend + server/ backend).

scripts.validate: cd app && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && cd ../server && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.validate:app: cd app && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.validate:server: cd server && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.validate:typecheck: cd app && npm run typecheck && cd ../server && npm run typecheck
scripts.validate:lint: cd app && npm run lint && cd ../server && npm run lint
scripts.validate:test: cd app && npm test && cd ../server && npm test
